flags.description: choose port to listen on, or source port to connect out from

flags.name: -r
flags.description: infinitely respawn/reconnect, pause for n seconds between connection attempts. -r0 can be used to re-listen after disconnect (just like a regular daemon)

flags.name: -n
flags.description: toggle numeric-only IP addresses (don't do DNS resolution). if you specify -n twice, original state will be active (i.e. -n works like a on/off switch)

flags.name: -m
flags.description: toggle monitoring (snooping) on/off (only used with the -e option). snooping can also be turned on by specifying -vv (-v two times)

flags.description: print version banner and exit (include that output in your bug report and send bug report to michel.blomgren@tigerteam.se)
